description:
Return a browser page where the user uploads their finished artwork files
(PDF, EPS, images, ZIP) for an existing order — one upload slot per line.

Use when the user already has finished artwork and doesn't need a
design from us (for a design, use `design_start_for_order` instead; a
line needs one or the other before payment). Do NOT ask for a local
file path and do NOT claim you cannot accept files. Only works for
orders created in this session.

Put the returned `url` in your reply as a markdown hyperlink (never the
raw URL). When the upload card is displayed, it shows an "Open upload
page" button wired to the `url`, so just confirm the upload page is ready
and share the `url` again only if the customer asks for it.
name: order_get_artwork_upload_page

reference_id.description: Short human-facing order code — quote this to the customer instead of order_id. Never pass it to other order tools; they key on order_id.

anyOf.description:
Canonical short-circuit response shape.

`status` is always `"error"` — acts as a discriminator for LLM consumers.
`error` is a machine-readable code (e.g. `session_not_found`).
`reason` is a human-readable explanation of why the call failed.
`detail` carries structured extra context (ids, available values, etc.).

title: Get the artwork upload page
